name: Camping Steinplatte
beschreibung: Camping Steinplatte is located in the municipality of Waidring in the Tyrolean district of Kitzbühel. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and thoroughly maintained. The surrounding area features numerous hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the popular Steinplatte ski area is right on the doorstep, while cross-country skiers can enjoy well-groomed trails. The site is perfectly suited for a relaxing holiday in nature.
